mapper.select: SELECT mp.id AS id, mp.user_id AS userId, mp.plan_date AS planDate, mp.meal_type AS mealType, mp.recipe_id AS recipeId, mp.sort_order AS sortOrder, mp.create_time AS createTime, r.title AS recipeTitle, r.cover_images AS recipeCoverImages, r.rating AS recipeRating, r.description AS recipeDescription, COALESCE(f.cnt, 0) AS recipeFavoriteCount FROM meal_plan mp LEFT JOIN recipe r ON mp.recipe_id = r.recipe_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT recipe_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM favorite GROUP BY recipe_id) f ON r.recipe_id = f.recipe_id WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId} AND mp.plan_date = #{planDate} ORDER BY mp.meal_type, mp.sort_order, mp.create_time
